blocks.text: The Committee members shall be registered voters of the City of Topeka and the Committee shall be as representative as possible of the City. (Ord. 20206 § 76, 9-10-19; Ord. 19320 § 5, 10-13-09. Code 1995 § 2-12. Formerly 2.13.030.)
